(a) The mounting arrangement for each engine and its supporting structure must be designed for a limit load factor in a lateral direction, for the sideload on the engine mount, of not less than (1) 1.33; or (2) One-third of the limit load factor for flight condition A.
(b) The sideload prescribed in sub-paragraph (a) of this paragraph may be assumed to be independent of other flight conditions.
